title: Welcome to Natural Hypertrophy
summary: First channel video. He explains the channel will document his natural bodybuilding journey (growing the body naturally, not the pro sport) through lifting vlogs filmed in his garage gym, measurable per-body-part size goals with taped measurements, and later informative videos and some anime talk.

claims.claim: The channel documents his bodybuilding journey, where bodybuilding means expanding the body's ability to get bigger, outside the professional sport.
The natural aspect is central: the point is to show how big the body can get without drugs.
All his training is done and filmed in his own garage gym, starting with short lifting vlogs showing his lifts and lifting philosophy, with informative videos later.
He sets clear numeric size goals per body part, e.g. reaching an 18-inch arm, and films the workouts toward them.
He will tape-measure body parts on camera to prove progress, then recap what worked, what didn't, and what he advises, for arms, calves, thighs, forearms, neck and more.
Anime is a source of motivation for his training, so the channel will include some anime talk.
